pages.text: Apple Annual Report 2025. This document outlines the financial performance of Apple Inc. for the fiscal year 2025.
Financial Summary: Net sales increased from the previous year. Revenue increased by 12% in fiscal year 2025, driven by strong demand. The company generated $391 billion in annual revenue.
iPhone demand remained strong throughout the year. Operating margin improved slightly compared to the prior fiscal year.
